spl_product_data_elements: Tricalm Hydrogel Aluminum acetate BUTYLENE GLYCOL GLYCINE HEXYLENE GLYCOL PHENOXYETHANOL ALUMINUM ACETATE ALUMINUM CATION CAPRYLYL GLYCOL DEHYDROACETIC ACID ETHYLHEXYLGLYCERIN MALIC ACID STRONTIUM CHLORIDE HEXAHYDRATE WATER XANTHAN GUM
indications_and_usage: For the temporary relief of minor skin irritations due to: poison ivy poison oak poison sumac insect bites rashes caused by soaps, detergents, cosmetics, or jewelry athlete's foot
warnings: For external use only. When using this product avoid contact with eyes; if contact occurs, rinse thoroughly with water Stop use and ask a doctor if condition worsens or symptoms last for more than 7 days
keep_out_of_reach_of_children: If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
dosage_and_administration: adults and children two years of age and older, apply to affected areas as needed or as directed by a physician consult a physician for children under the age of two
inactive_ingredient: butylene glycol, caprylyl glycol, dehydroacetic acid, ethylhexylglycerin, glycine, hexylene glycol, malic acid, phenoxyethanol, strontium chloride hexahydrate, water, xanthan gum
